description: This source file contains the ArticlesController class, which defines API endpoints for managing articles in the web application. It includes methods for retrieving articles, article feeds, individual article details, creation, editing, and deletion, utilizing MediatR for processing commands and queries.

classes.name: ArticlesController
classes.description: Controller handling article-related HTTP requests such as listing, retrieving, creating, editing, and deleting articles.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests for listing articles with optional filtering parameters.

methods.name: GetFeed
methods.description: Handles GET requests for fetching a personalized feed of articles.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles GET requests for retrieving a specific article by its slug.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new article, requiring authorization.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing article identified by its slug, requiring authorization.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an article identified by its slug, requiring authorization.
